meta.name: gpt-taste
meta.description: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造高级UI动效与排版布局
copy.tagline_en: Create advanced UI animations and typographic layouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you pursue top-tier visual experience and GSAP motion design.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先输出 design_plan,再写 React/Tailwind 页面代码。它按 AIDA 结构组织版面,用模拟 Python 随机选版式、字体和 GSAP 动效,并强制标题限 2-3 行、Bento 网格无空隙。
howto.when: 当你要求它制作网页、落地页或 React 组件时,它会接管界面设计;涉及 GSAP 动画或版式细节时,也会套用这套规则。

say.text: 帮我做个作品集落地页,要求用 GSAP 滚动固定和文字擦除效果。
say.note: 它会先出设计计划,再按规范写代码。

say.text: 设计一个 Bento 网格首页,标题压到两三行,格子不能有空缺。
say.note: 会执行无空隙网格检查。

say.text: 做一个 AIDA 结构的营销页,字体和版式用模拟 Python 随机选。
say.note: 会按要求执行随机化流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first outputs a design_plan and then writes React/Tailwind page code. It structures layouts by AIDA, uses simulated Python to randomize layout, fonts, and GSAP effects, and enforces 2-3 line headings and gapless Bento grids.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask for a website, landing page, or React component; it also applies the spec when you mention GSAP animations or typography details.

say_en.text: Build me a portfolio landing page with GSAP scroll pinning and text reveal effects.
say_en.note: It will write a design plan first, then code.

say_en.text: Design a Bento grid homepage with headings kept to 2-3 lines and no empty cells.
say_en.note: It will run the gapless grid check.

say_en.text: Make an AIDA marketing page with simulated Python choosing fonts and layout.
say_en.note: It will follow the randomization flow.
